benchmark_scope: Generic approximately 1 MtCO2/year liquid-solvent DAC plus geologic-storage corridor archetype; not an actual plant design, siting, permit, cost forecast, or investment recommendation.
paired_case_rule: Only uptime, task hours, and automation-task costs differ. All physical, emissions, deliverability, crediting, price, capital, and funding parameters come from the shared parameter table.

cases.interpretation: Reference operating organization at the NETL conceptual-case capacity factor; staffing hours are placeholders, not observed workforce data.
Mechanism test only: fewer task hours and higher uptime offset by an explicit automation-system cost. This is not field validation or a forecast cost reduction.

failure_cases.description: Only half of baseline annual electricity is deliverable.
Only half of the baseline annual thermal-service allowance, expressed as an HHV fuel-input-equivalent proxy, is available.
Only half of baseline annual storage acceptance is available.
The current-load settlement base falls by half without compensating legacy funding.
Current-load settlements remain, but the separate legacy-drawdown funding source is absent.
Independent verification is unavailable; the benchmark's fail-closed rule stops operation and credit issuance.
